annotation.title_clean: H.R. 2864: To amend the Secure and Trusted Communications Networks Act of 2019 to add DJI Technologies equipment and services to the covered list
annotation.title_en: H.R. 2864: To amend the Secure and Trusted Communications Networks Act of 2019 to add DJI Technologies equipment and services to the covered list
named_instruments_referenced: Secure and Trusted Communications Networks Act of 2019
annotation.summary_en: House bill H.R. 2864 (118th Congress), introduced April 25, 2023 by Rep. Stefanik and Rep. Gallagher. It would amend the Secure and Trusted Communications Networks Act of 2019 to add DJI Technologies' equipment and services to the FCC covered list, treating Chinese drone maker DJI as a national security risk. It was referred to the Energy and Commerce Committee.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends the Secure and Trusted Communications Networks Act of 2019.
Adds DJI Technologies equipment and services to the covered communications equipment or services list.
Introduced April 25, 2023 and referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce.
Targets a Chinese drone manufacturer on national security grounds.
